sentences.text:
Counsel for Applicant :- Anil Kumar Yadav,Achal Singh Yadav
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and perused the record.

2. It is argued by counsel for the applicant that in terms of the F.I.R., it was alleged that the applicant used to stay on a rented accommodation near the home of the informant where both of them met and on account of giving job they became very close.
It was further alleged that applicant used to take a lot of money from her and further victim was emotionally blackmailed and wrong was also committed on her.
The tentative age of the victim is around 28 years.
Applicant is in jail since 30.05.2024 however, he has no criminal history.

3. Learned A.G.A. opposed the bail prayer.

4. Considering the age of the victim prima facie relationship appears to be consensual, in view thereof, the applicant who is in jail since 30.05.2024 having no criminal history is entitled to be released on bail.
Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

5. Let the applicant- Vipin Kumar Yadav Alias Vipin Kumar be released on bail in FIR/ Case Crime No.0300 of 2024, under Sections 376, 406, 506 IPC, Police Station PGI, District Lucknow on his furnishing personal bonds and two reliable sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade them from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
Order Date :- 15.7.2024 Saurabh Yadav/-
